jobs.title: UI Software Engineer - WPF/.NET Desktop Applications
jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced WPF GUI Engineer to design and build the user interface for our real-time digital oscilloscope platform. You'll own the software layer responsible for rendering high-speed waveform data, live measurements, and instrument controls on embedded Windows hardware.

What You'll Do

Design and implement WPF interfaces for real-time waveform display, including live trace rendering, persistence modes, and multi-channel overlays
Implement instrument-control UI: trigger configuration, timebase/voltage scaling, channel setup, cursors, and automated measurements (rise time, frequency, amplitude, etc.)
Design UI behavior for deep memory acquisition, waveform decimation/downsampling for display, and zoom/pan across captured records
Build touch- and knob/encoder-friendly interfaces for front-panel hardware controls alongside on-screen UI
Ensure UI stability and responsiveness during sustained real-time operation (hours/days of continuous capture)
Implement MVVM architecture that cleanly separates acquisition data models from rendering and control logic

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience building WPF applications for desktop or embedded Windows environments
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with experience in performance-critical, real-time-adjacent UI code
Deep understanding of MVVM, data binding, dependency properties, and custom control/template development in XAML
Solid grasp of multithreading and producer/consumer patterns for handling continuous data acquisition feeds without blocking the UI thread
Strong debugging and profiling skills for latency, frame timing, and memory usage in long-running applications

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with user interface technologies such as QT or Avalonia
Experience with SciChart graphical software
Familiarity with oscilloscope concepts: triggering, sampling theory, FFT/spectral display
Experience with GPU-accelerated rendering (DirectX, SharpDX, Vortice.Windows, or similar)
Familiarity with Windows IoT Enterprise or embedded Windows deployment for instrument-grade hardware
Exposure to industry-standard remote instrument control protocols (SCPI, VISA, LXI)
Experience interfacing with embedded acquisition hardware (FPGA, ADC front-ends, or similar) via shared memory, DMA buffers, or custom drivers

Other Information

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below.

Colorado Pay Range MIN $110,740.00, Mid. $147,650.00, MAX $184,570.00

Note:
For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region

This position is on-site in Colorado Springs , Colorado

Relocation is available for this position

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position

This position requires access to technology and/or technical data that is subject to U.S. export controls. Candidates need to be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

US Employees May Be Eligible For The Following Benefits

Medical, dental and vision
Health Savings Account
Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
Life, Accident, Disability insurance
Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health
401(k) Plan
Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays
Paid Family Leave
Discounts, Perks
Tuition Reimbursement
Adoption Assistance
ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan)

jobs.title: Embedded software engineer
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer

We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Technology Engineering Team at Neurotechnology.

About The Opportunity

At Neurotechnology, we focus on a broad range of R&D activities, including BCI and EEG, AI, Biometrics, and NLP. Our Engineering team plays a central role in developing tools for BCI and EEG systems, with additional involvement in other areas when needed. We encourage a clear and collaborative environment where people share knowledge, explore new ideas, and develop technology that is precise and reliable. Curiosity and continuous learning guide our everyday work.

Job Description

The Technology Engineering Team is seeking an Embedded Software Developer to contribute to our rising project – the EEG-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) platform brainaccess.ai. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing firmware for existing EEG devices, implementing new features from initial concept to final deployment, and leading firmware development for future EEG and other hardware products. The role requires close collaboration with electronics engineers and direct involvement in the device manufacturing and integration process.

Requirements

Strong expertise in C++ and embedded software development
Hands-on experience with ESP32 and ESP-IDF framework
Familiarity with FreeRTOS or other real-time operating systems
Basic understanding of electronics and circuit principles

Advantages

Knowledge of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology
Understanding of SPI and I2C communication protocols
Ability to develop low-level, register-based device drivers
Experience with version control, especially Git
Independent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

We offer

Work on innovative projects at the intersection of neuroscience and technology
Collaboration with passionate, multidisciplinary teams
Hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Private health insurance
Flexible work schedule
Professional learning opportunities
Motivating bonuses

Monthly salary starts from 2500 EUR (gross)
, depending on the level of experience.

Join Neurotechnology team and become a part of exciting BCI and EEG projects!

Contact us today.

If you are interested, please send your CV to career@neurotechnology.com.
